title: Hate Speech in Pixels: Detection of Offensive Memes towards Automatic Moderation
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development of a multimodal system for detecting hate speech in memes. While the dataset specifically includes categories targeting religious groups (Jewish and Muslim) and the task relates to the ethics of content moderation, the study is a classification performance task rather than an evaluation or benchmarking of religious tenets, moral reasoning, or ethical frameworks.
